# Enable Vault UI telemetry gathering

Collect anonymous usage analytics about how operators interact with the Vault
web UI. UI telemetry is disabled by default and requires two independent
opt-ins: an operator must enable it in the server configuration, and each user
must grant consent in the browser.

## Before you start

- **You must have Vault 2.2.0 or later installed and running**.
- **You must have access to your [Vault configuration](/vault/docs/configuration) file**.
- **You must have the Vault web UI enabled** (`ui = true`).
- **You must be able to restart your Vault nodes** to apply configuration changes.

## Step 1: Enable UI telemetry in your configuration

Add a `ui_settings` stanza to your Vault configuration and set `ui_telemetry` to
`true`. The stanza is available in both Community and Enterprise editions.

```hcl
ui = true

ui_settings {
  ui_telemetry = true
}
```

UI telemetry stays off unless you set `ui_telemetry` to `true`. Setting it to
`false`, or omitting the stanza, keeps telemetry disabled.

## Step 2: Restart Vault

Restart your Vault nodes so the new configuration takes effect. Vault reads UI
settings at startup and does not reload them on `SIGHUP`.

## Step 3: Confirm the setting

Read the UI settings endpoint to confirm Vault advertises telemetry as enabled:

```shell-session
$ vault read sys/internal/ui/settings

Key                   Value
---                   -----
ui_telemetry_enabled  true
```

The web UI reads this endpoint to decide whether to prompt users for consent.

## Step 4: Users grant consent

Enabling telemetry in the configuration does not, by itself, collect any data.
When UI telemetry is enabled, the web UI prompts each user to opt in. Vault
gathers events only after a user grants consent, and never collects PII,
secrets, or request bodies.

Users can grant or withdraw consent at any time from **User preferences ->
Data & Privacy -> Share usage metrics**.

For the full list of events and properties Vault gathers once a user consents,
see [UI telemetry events](/vault/docs/internals/telemetry/metrics/ui-telemetry-events).
